verified: ULA's own statement says it has completed an initial integrated review of flight data from the Leo 1 launch anomaly and that preliminary indications point to inadequate fuel supply to the BE-4 engines rather than engine performance.
unconfirmed: the actual root cause, whether the fix requires changes to vehicle plumbing, feed systems or procedures, and when Vulcan will fly again — ULA explicitly says work remains, and the finding is preliminary and self-reported, with no independent review or full investigation report released.

verified: ULA 官方声明称，已完成对 Leo 1 发射异常飞行数据的初步综合审查，初步迹象表明助推级推力偏低是火箭向 BE-4 发动机供油不足所致，而非发动机性能所致。
unconfirmed: 故障的具体根本原因、供油不足是设计、制造还是操作层面的问题、是否波及其他 Vulcan 任务及复飞时间表；ULA 明确表示调查仍在进行，上述细节均未公布。

titles.en: ULA says Vulcan failure traced to inadequate fuel supply, not BE-4 engines
titles.zh: ULA：Vulcan 发射失败源于 BE-4 发动机燃料供应不足
